There is a small lace museum called Museo del Merletto. Opinions on it vary from "not much to see" to "I didn't think I was interested in lace, but I spent 90 minutes in there". A MUVE museum.
Famous people, including royalty, visited the place. The walls are covered with their photo's.
Precious mosaics, dating from Byzantine times, in the oldest cathedral in the lagoon of Venice. Campanile closed for restoration.
Has the form of a Greek cross, which is surrounded by a semi-octagonal porticus.
Lunch daily; May-Sep: evenings Fri Sat and by reservation (min. 8/10 people)
